summary: Backend-only end-to-end testing for AVR Organics (Herbal Bloom) API. Created pytest suite covering products, categories, support info, auth (Emergent OAuth session validation, Bearer token via seeded user_sessions), full cart CRUD with subtotal aggregation, order creation (verified razorpay_order_id is a mock_<id> string when keys are blank), mock-pay flow (clears cart + marks paid), review purchase enforcement (403 pre-purchase, 200 post-purchase, upsert single-row behavior), admin gating (403 for non-admin), admin support update reflected via /support/info, and admin product CRUD with GET verification. 19/19 tests passed. Cleaned up DB after tests; support settings reset to defaults.

minor.issue: N+1 review aggregation in list endpoint — each product triggers a separate $group aggregation. Not a bug, but will slow as catalog grows. Consider single $lookup or computing on review write.

Race condition possible: first user becomes admin via count==0 check. Not a bug for current scope, but if two requests arrive concurrently both could pass the check. Recommend relying on ADMIN_EMAILS env exclusively.
Returns {ok:true} even if the product did not exist (deleted_count==0). Consider returning 404 when nothing was deleted.

action_items: Razorpay keys are intentionally blank — verified mock_<uuid> fallback works end-to-end. Add real RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET and remove /api/orders/{id}/mock-pay (or gate it behind a flag) before production.
Frontend env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL as referenced in the testing guide). Confirm the frontend reads process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
Consider returning 404 from DELETE /api/admin/products/{id} when product not found (currently returns 200).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 700 lines — close to the recommended split threshold. Future feature additions should be moved into modules (routers/products.py, routers/orders.py, routers/admin.py, services/razorpay.py).
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded everywhere via projection {_id:0} — good.
All endpoints use async/await with motor — good.
Pydantic models validate input on all POST/PUT endpoints — good.
Razorpay signature verification properly uses HMAC SHA-256 — good.
Mock-pay endpoint requires Bearer auth and verifies order ownership — safe.
Review upsert correctly updates existing row instead of duplicating — verified.
seed_data_creation: Tests seed a TEST_user (is_admin=false) and TEST_admin (is_admin=true) directly into MongoDB users + user_sessions collections, cleaned up via fixture teardown. Test products created during admin CRUD are deleted in-test. Support settings were reset to defaults post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs)` then `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` from /app. Env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Auth uses Bearer <session_token> against /api/auth/me; sessions can be seeded directly into Mongo user_sessions collection. Mock-pay endpoint at POST /api/orders/{id}/mock-pay is the substitute for real Razorpay until keys are added.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
